title: PackageObjectiveState
description: Tracked local or shared objective state with independent knownness flags.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

registration_id.description: Registration required for attempt-lifetime state, absent for a verified cross-attempt learner scope.
registration_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

activity_attempt_id.description: Owning local activity attempt when not shared.
activity_attempt_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

objective_scope.description: Whether objective uses local or explicitly mapped shared scope.

external_key.description: Exact objective identifier in its configured scope.

satisfaction_known.description: True when satisfaction flag is initialized.

satisfied.description: Satisfaction value used only when known.

measure_known.description: True when normalized measure is initialized.

completion_known.description: Whether edition-supported mapped completion is initialized.

completed.description: Completion value used only when known.

progress_known.description: Whether edition-supported mapped progress is initialized.

raw_score.description: Known edition-supported objective raw score lexical value.

minimum_score.description: Known edition-supported objective minimum lexical value.

maximum_score.description: Known edition-supported objective maximum lexical value.

revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

institution_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve in the exact owning Institution.

learner_person_id.description: Exact authorized learner whose state may be shared.
learner_person_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve in the exact owning Institution.

organization_id.description: Manifest organization when sharing is limited to its tree.
organization_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve in the exact owning Institution.

persistence_scope.description: Resolved persistence scope from edition manifest and explicit tenant trust profile.

resolved_scope_key.description: Unambiguous identity for local attempt, tree attempt, tree-across-attempts or approved learner-wide scope.

x-invariants: Enforce one scoped objective per registration and objective key with local attempt included where applicable.
A missing measure is distinct from zero.
